hooks.command: raw=$(python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$raw" ] && exit 0; f=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *backend/src/persistency/database/models/base/*) exit 0 ;; */backend/src/persistency/database/models/__init__.py) exit 0 ;; */backend/src/persistency/database/models/*.py) ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); mkdir -p .claude; log=.claude/auto-migrate.log; printf '[%s] auto-migrate triggered by %s\n' "$ts" "$f" >> "$log"; running=$(docker compose ps --status running --services 2>/dev/null | grep -x backend); if [ -z "$running" ]; then printf '[%s] SKIP: backend container is not running. Run `make up` then `make add-migration name="auto_%s"` manually.\n' "$ts" "$ts" >> "$log"; exit 0; fi; make add-migration name="auto_${ts}" >> "$log" 2>&1 || true ;; esac
